profile: New York operations executive who turns strategy into disciplined execution across human capital, technology, procurement, facilities, and government-funded contracts. Led a 140-person, multi-site division with full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio, overseeing IT systems, facilities, and vendor contracts and running HR for programs with hundreds of workers under New York employment law. Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts, negotiated $10M+ in government and institutional contracts, and leads audit readiness and grant compliance reviews. Reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% surplus through workflow redesign and controls. Leads AI adoption in operations, having built SkyNet, an AI workflow now in daily use. Trusted partner to CEOs and Boards, including Finance and Audit Committees.
capabilities: Human Capital, Total Rewards & HR Compliance

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Built and piloted SkyNet, an AI-supported workflow for research, evaluation, document preparation, and engagement tracking, now in full daily use; leads AI adoption for client operations.
Maintain KPI tracking for grant-funded programs with daily updates and monthly and quarterly compliance reviews against funder and contract requirements.
Lead annual audit coordination and readiness testing for workforce development, healthcare, and smaller 501(c)(3) organizations.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Held full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Oversaw IT systems, facilities, and vendor contracts supporting multi-site program operations.
Ran HR for a workforce program overseeing hundreds of workers, including hiring, supervision, compensation, and employee relations under New York employment law; wrote the HR manuals.
Led 12 direct reports across finance, grant stewardship, and operations through weekly operating reviews, individual check-ins, and clear performance measures.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Modernized payment processes, redesigned workflows, and introduced compliance meetings and staff self-assessments as part of the deficit-to-surplus turnaround.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Created and administered employee retirement plans, including at Alluel Logistics and for Maroon Strategist clients.
Served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative, supporting capital planning and financial structuring.
Developed operational and performance-improvement strategies for $50M+ organizations and major brands.
Built accounting, governance, and operational infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti.
Built HR, payroll, benefits, and training infrastructure for a team that grew from 4 to 60 full-time employees.
Founded and scaled a multi-location business from a $5K investment to a $1M enterprise; delivered 33% YoY revenue growth and an 11% margin improvement.
